news.title:
MOSL, Nuvama, and Elara remain bullish on Concor despite weak Q4 results.
Concor, a Navratna railway stock, continues to draw attention from analysts.
Motilal Oswal retains Buy on CONCOR, cuts target price to ₹560 from ₹600.
Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹16.36 (down from ₹16.92 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹94.4b (up 6.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹12.4b (down 3.6% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 13% (down from 14% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 11%. Revenue is forecast to grow 10.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.9% growth forecast for the Transportation industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 4% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 4% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: CONCOR: Vizhinjam Logistics MoU Will Support Long Term Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have made a slight upward tweak to Container Corporation of India’s fair value estimate to ₹566.41 per share, citing modest adjustments to the discount rate and future P/E assumptions, while keeping revenue growth and profit margin expectations broadly unchanged. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on March 6, 2026 to consider the appointment of Shri Harbrinder Singh Bajwa as Director (Domestic Division), signaling upcoming changes in senior leadership responsibilities (company filing).

news.title: CONCOR: Maritime JV And New Port Projects Will Support Balanced Long Term Prospects
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Container Corporation of India slightly to around ₹565, reflecting updated assumptions that combine a modest change in fair value with a small adjustment to discount rate, revenue growth and profit margin expectations, alongside a steady future P/E estimate. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for May 25, 2026 to consider audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and a possible final dividend for 2025-26, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming AGM (company filing).

news.title: CONCOR: New Shipping JV And Vizhinjam MoU Will Test Elevated P/E
news.body: Analysts have reduced their price target on Container Corporation of India by ₹0 to ₹457, citing slightly higher discount rates, modest adjustments to revenue growth and profit margin expectations, and a revised future P/E assumption. What's in the News Container Corporation of India signed a non binding, non exclusive MoU with Vizhinjam International Seaport Ltd on 23 February 2026 to develop a Container Freight Station near Vizhinjam International Seaports in Kerala, with VISL providing land on mutually agreed terms (company announcement).

news.title: CONCOR: Future Maritime JV Is Expected To Unlock Undervalued Logistics Potential
news.body: Analysts have trimmed the price target on Container Corporation of India to ₹565.88 from ₹582.53, citing updated assumptions for fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that indicate a slightly more conservative outlook on the shares. What's in the News Signed a non binding, non exclusive MoU with Vizhinjam International Seaport Ltd.

news.title: CONCOR: New Shipping JV And Port MoU Will Test Rich P/E
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Container Corporation of India steady at ₹457, citing only modest tweaks to revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E assumptions rather than any material change in their fundamental view. What's in the News Signed a non binding, non exclusive MoU with Vizhinjam International Seaport Ltd on 23 February 2026 to develop a Container Freight Station near Vizhinjam port in Kerala, with facilities such as customs bonded area, warehouse, container yards, import export cargo handling, weighbridges and related services, subject to a detailed collaboration agreement to be finalized later (company filing).

news.title: CONCOR: New Port And Shipping Ventures Will Support Long-Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Container Corporation of India slightly lower from about ₹720.74 to ₹704.16, reflecting updated assumptions that include a modestly lower revenue growth outlook, a small improvement in expected profit margins, and a slightly adjusted future P/E multiple and discount rate. What's in the News Container Corporation of India and Vizhinjam International Seaport signed a non binding, non exclusive MoU on 23 February 2026 to develop a Container Freight Station near Vizhinjam port in Kerala, with planned facilities such as a customs bonded area, warehouse, container yards, cargo handling and weighbridges to support end to end services for EXIM trade (company announcement).

news.title: CONCOR: Rich P E Will Face Pressure From New Shipping JV Risk
news.body: Analysts have maintained their ₹457 price target for Container Corporation of India, with small tweaks to inputs such as a slightly lower discount rate, marginally higher revenue growth and profit margin assumptions, and a modestly lower future P/E helping to support the unchanged valuation. What's in the News Container Corporation of India, Shipping Corporation of India, V.O. Chidambarnar Port Authority, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Chennai Port Authority and Sagarmala Finance Corporation signed an MoU on February 3, 2026 to form Bharat Container Shipping Line, a joint venture focused on acquiring, owning, leasing and operating container vessels, containers and related assets for EXIM and coastal trade, with planned stakes of 30% each for CONCOR and SCI, 10% for JNPA, 5% each for VOCP

news.title: CONCOR: Softer Margins And Dividend Decision Will Pressure Rich P E Expectations
news.body: Analysts now place their price target for Container Corporation of India closer to ₹457 from roughly ₹459, aligning fair value a touch lower as they factor in slightly softer assumptions for revenue, profit margins and discount rates, along with a modestly higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News A Board meeting is scheduled for January 29, 2026, at 15:00 IST to review the Limited Review Report issued by the statutory auditors and to approve standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and period ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.40 (vs ₹4.81 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.40 (down from ₹4.81 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹24.0b (up 8.7% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.34b (down 8.9% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (down from 17% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.5% growth forecast for the Transportation industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 5% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 1% per year.

news.title: CONCOR: Vadhvan Rail Role And Cement Logistics Will Support Long-Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Container Corporation of India slightly lower to ₹720.74 from ₹721.11, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, discount rate, and future P/E that together point to only a marginal refinement in their overall price target framework. What's in the News The Board has scheduled a meeting on January 29, 2026, to review and approve unaudited financial results for the quarter and period ended December 31, 2025, and to consider a 3rd interim dividend for FY 2025-26, if any (company filing).

news.title: CONCOR: Vadhvan Port Rail Role Will Support Long-Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Container Corporation of India from ₹725.29 to ₹721.11 as they adjust assumptions around slightly higher revenue growth, a lower profit margin and a higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News CONCOR signed an MoU with Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority and Vadhvan Port Project Limited to develop and manage common rail handling operations for all upcoming container terminals at the proposed Vadhvan Port Project, with an estimated investment of about 500 million to be implemented in phases and a proposed commencement year of 2030 (company announcement).

news.title: CONCOR: Rail Cement Logistics Agreements Will Drive Long-Term Earnings Upside
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Container Corporation of India slightly lower from ₹730.00 to ₹725.29, as modestly higher long term growth and margin expectations are more than offset by a reduced valuation multiple outlook. What's in the News Signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority to act as the Common Rail Handling Operator for all upcoming container terminals at the proposed Vadhvan Port, involving an estimated investment of about 500 million and targeted commencement in 2030 (Key Developments).
